name: aftereffects-mcp-imt
display_name: AE-MCP-IMT — After Effects for AI agents
description: Drive a running Adobe After Effects from Claude: comps, layers, effects, keyframes, text, masks, expressions, render frames.
long_description: AE-MCP-IMT by Immersive Media Technologies. 199 undo-grouped After Effects operations behind two tools, a real dry run, effect presets that work on localized AE, honest errors, no telemetry; ships the AE Motion skill for editable motion graphics. Requires Adobe After Effects 2024+ running on this computer. Non-commercial license; unofficial, not affiliated with Adobe Inc.

readOnly.title: Read-only mode
readOnly.description: On: nothing may modify the After Effects project — inspect, render frames, dry-run only. Recommended for the first session on a new machine.

enableEval.title: Allow arbitrary ExtendScript (eval.run)
enableEval.description: Off by default. Arbitrary scripts can touch the file system; enable only for a trusted agent.

aePath.title: After Effects path
aePath.description: Optional. Leave empty to auto-detect AE 2024–2026 in /Applications or Program Files. macOS: the .app bundle; Windows: AfterFX.exe.
